name: codex-edge
description: Unofficial Windows compatibility plugin for controlling Microsoft Edge from Codex Desktop.

interface.shortDescription: Use Microsoft Edge from Codex on Windows.
interface.longDescription: Routes Codex browser tasks explicitly to Microsoft Edge and provides privacy-conscious diagnostics for the local browser bridge. Requires Codex Desktop and the official ChatGPT browser extension installed in Edge.
defaultPrompt: Use Microsoft Edge to work with the current page.
Open this public website in Edge and inspect it.
Diagnose my Codex Edge connection without changing files.
